Cost Firewall Featured

4/10/2026
open-sourcecloudcost-management

Cost Firewall helps you monitor and control your cloud spending across multiple providers.

Features

  • Real-time cost tracking
  • Budget alerts
  • Multi-cloud support
  • Custom dashboards
  • Cost allocation by team

Getting Started

npm install cost-firewall

Configuration

Create a cost-firewall.config.js file:

export default {
  providers: ['aws', 'gcp', 'azure'],
  budget: 1000,
  alerts: ['email', 'slack']
}
Visit: https://iherb.com/cost-firewall
